summary: Completed backend + frontend auth regression for Emergent Google and OTP fallback on the public preview URL. Backend pytest passed (19/19) after fixing test isolation; UI validation confirmed Google CTA redirect initiation, invalid callback exchange/error recovery, OTP login, cookie-based restore after reload, and authenticated home load. Production frontend build compiled successfully with no warnings/errors.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout observed after 6 consecutive invalid OTP attempts; endpoint kept returning generic 400 without temporary lock/block.

action_items: Implement OTP brute-force protection (e.g., attempt counter + cooldown/lockout after 5 failures).
Retest with a real institutional Google login to fully verify persisted Google session fields in DB (stable user_id reuse, 7-day expiry record) end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Google session persistence logic appears correct in code review: user lookup uses projection excluding _id, user_id is reused from existing record when present, and expires_at is stored as now + 7 days.
Could not fully assert Google persistence behavior through live API without a valid institutional Google account/session_id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested testable flows without real Google credentials

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Runtime test requests/transactions were process-local. Auth fallback remains MOCKED OTP 123456.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://resource-loop-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Invalid #session_id triggers POST /api/auth/google/session and returns onboarding with visible error + cleared fragment. OTP login and cookie restore after reload work. Google CTA jumps into Google Accounts flow (managed chain). Frontend build passes cleanly. Remaining gap: no lockout on repeated invalid OTP and no real Google account available for full persistence E2E verification.
rca of the issue: OTP verification currently checks challenge presence/value only and does not track per-email/IP failure counts or cooldown state, so repeated invalid attempts are never rate-limited/locked. Mitigation: persist failed_attempts + locked_until in OTP challenge/session store and enforce lockout after threshold (e.g., 5 attempts).
